value.text: Registration for Ada's Preschool Swim opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7:00 p.m. Eastern, and I can join the line for you right at the open. I saw two sessions: Sat 9:00 ($98) and Sun 10:00 ($98). Which do you want, in order? One more thing: if you also queue yourself on your phone or computer, you'd hold two places in line, and the town's queue counts that against you, so it's best to leave the line to me.
